verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop and mobile meeting-notes app, so the axis applies. The pack documents only an opt-out from model training, which is a related but different control from opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. Nothing in the pack describes a telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking toggle, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
